bugs.summary: The profiling warnings pass self._get_mm_num_tokens(mm_inputs), a dict, as a format arg to logger.warning_once, which is the lru_cache-wrapped _print_warning_once, so when the V0 profiling length check fires it raises TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict' instead of logging.
bugs.evidence: profiling.py:224 and :249 pass `self._get_mm_num_tokens(mm_inputs)`; _get_mm_num_tokens returns a dict comprehension (profiling.py:185-194); logger.warning_once is bound to `_print_warning_once` via MethodType (logger.py:133-139), which is `@lru_cache` (logger.py:61-64) so all args are hashed for the cache key. Fixed within the same PR by commit 7830858f ('chore: make it hashable'), which wraps both args in str(...); reviewer DarkLight1337: 'It doesn't work because the function is wrapped in lru_cache'. Model findings that flag the generic 'unhashable *args through lru_cache' at logger.py:55-75 (R2: 00,01,12,22,composite-*,v-*) describe this same defect at its root; the concrete trigger at head is the dict at profiling.py:224/:249.

rejected.was: AACR: lru_cache keyed on *args breaks 'print once' semantics (logger.py:55-58) (also R2 00,21,22,v-every-instance-low,v-no-speculation-medium,v-sweep-low)
rejected.why: Not a regression: before the PR call sites embedded the values in f-strings, so the cache key already differed per value; dedupe semantics are unchanged.

rejected.was: AACR: unbounded lru_cache growth with dynamic args (logger.py:55-58) (also R2 21,v-sweep-low)
rejected.why: Same as above: the pre-PR f-string messages already produced one cache entry per distinct value.

rejected.was: AACR: weight_utils warning_once may not accept *args (weight_utils.py:718-721)
rejected.why: warning_once accepts *args at head (logger.py:83-88) and forwards them to logger.warning.

rejected.was: AACR: %s vs %d for token counts; double space before noqa (also R2 12: '#  noqa' double space)
rejected.why: Style only; %s formats any value correctly. flake8 matches '#\s*noqa', so the double space still suppresses E501.
